baseline_prompt_en: A small bird on a grassy patch has landed with folded wings. Its feet touch the grass, with the toes sitting across the nearby blades beneath its body. A long lens and shallow depth of field keep the bird and those contacts readable while the farther grass softens. Soft daylight reveals fine feather edges and the arc of its folded wing. The frame gives the bird and its landing contact priority over the background.
